messages.subject: Error while publishing ShinyApp
parts:
Hi,

I successfully developed an application and tested multiple times in my lapto (Windows 7 - 64 bit). The app generates 5 models (XGBoost, H2O Deep Learning, H2O GBM, GLMNet, randomForest) and predicts the Target.

But when I publish this to Shinyapps, it gives the following error. Application URL: https://socrates.shinyapps.io/HousingLoanApprovalSystem/

Can you please help?

Thanks!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Error while publishing ShinyApp
parts: Looks like h2o consumed too much memory and was terminated. Try using a larger instance type, or passing a maximum memory size to h2o.init that is less than the amount of memory available for the instance type you are using

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Error while publishing ShinyApp
parts:
The large instance type has 1 GB of RAM and is the most available under the free plan.
If you limit the Java process to 1 GB, you will not be leaving anything for the R process.
If you look at your logs, you should be able to see that h2o was able to launch, it is just that once it started processing that it exceed the memory limit and was terminated.
